title: Privacy desk top dividers

spec_findings.notes: Global Industrial listing for the same PET felt privacy screen states exactly 30"W x 3/8"D x 12-1/2"H. Matches claim.

spec_findings.claimed: PET felt (polyester fiber, 50% post-recycled content); Steel clamp hardware
spec_findings.datasheet_value: PET felt = polyester fiber with 50% post-recycled content; 100% recyclable and non-toxic
spec_findings.notes: Global PET Felt Screens & Panels page confirms 50% post-recycled polyester fiber, 100% recyclable and non-toxic. 'PET felt' material correct (not fabric/PVB). Steel clamp hardware not explicitly itemized on datasheet but consistent with the clamp-mount system; minor.

spec_findings.claimed: Clamp-on mounting for 1" worksurfaces — no tools or drilling
spec_findings.datasheet_value: Mounts above and below a 1" worksurface using bracket/clamp supports; clamps for 1" surfaces only
spec_findings.notes: Datasheet confirms clamp compatibility with 1" worksurfaces and above-desk (privacy) / below-desk (modesty) use. 'No tools or drilling' is consistent with a clamp system but not verbatim on the datasheet.

spec_findings.datasheet_value: Described as 'sound absorbing materials'; no numeric NRC or STC published
spec_findings.notes: Claimed copy correctly stops at qualitative 'sound-absorbing' and does NOT assert a numeric rating. Datasheet likewise publishes no NRC/STC. No misstatement.

spec_findings.datasheet_value: Tested to meet/exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards (tested at Global's ISO 17025 in-house facility). No GREENGUARD or SCS stated.
spec_findings.notes: ANSI/BIFMA compliance supported. No GREENGUARD/SCS claimed by the SKU (correctly absent) and none published by Global for this line.

spec_findings.claimed: Limited Lifetime Warranty (Global panels; 5 years on textiles & electrical)
spec_findings.datasheet_value: Comprehensive Limited Lifetime Warranty (Global standard). The '5 years on textiles/electrical' is Global's general warranty tiering, not a PET-screen-specific clause.
spec_findings.recommended_correction: Retain 'Limited Lifetime Warranty'; remove or soften the '5 years on textiles & electrical' parenthetical (no electrical components on a felt screen; the textile sub-term is not datasheet-tied to this product).
spec_findings.notes: Lifetime portion VERIFIED and is the more generous, true term, so this is NOT a legal overstatement. Factual tidiness only — the electrical sub-clause cannot apply to a passive felt screen; textile sub-term unconfirmed for PET screens.

spec_findings.datasheet_value: Global Furniture Group manufactures in Toronto, Canada (corporate); specific PET-screen datasheet does not state country of manufacture at the SKU level.
spec_findings.recommended_correction: Highly plausible (Global is a Canadian manufacturer, Canadian pricelist), but obtain SKU-level confirmation before relying on 'Made in Canada' as a procurement/marketing claim. Do not present as datasheet-confirmed until verified.
spec_findings.notes: LEGALLY SENSITIVE. Corporate-level Canadian manufacturing is well documented, but no per-SKU country-of-origin statement was found on the PET felt datasheet. Treat as plausible-but-unconfirmed.

spec_findings.claimed: Nine felt finishes: Black, Brick, Denim, Graphite, Harvest, Mist, Pewter, Shamrock, White
spec_findings.datasheet_value: Global publishes a PET felt finishes palette (Mist confirmed via Global Industrial listing); full nine-colour list not enumerated on the pages retrieved.
spec_findings.recommended_correction: Confirm the exact finish names/count against the Global PET Felt finishes page or current CDN pricelist before publishing the nine-colour list.
spec_findings.notes: Mist is confirmed as a real finish. The specific nine names could not be confirmed from the retrieved pages; do not assert the list as datasheet-verified.

config_divergence_note: Item is categorized as 'acoustic-pods' but is actually a clamp-on PET felt desktop privacy/modesty SCREEN — not a sealed acoustic pod. It is a sound-absorbing screen/divider. Recategorize under privacy screens / dividers, not pods.

title: Global L-Shape Desk with 36"H Privacy Panel — 72"W x 72"D

spec_findings.claimed: Acoustic-pod category; L-shape laminate desk with desk-mounted privacy panel
spec_findings.datasheet_value: Divide is a modular DESK-MOUNTED PRIVACY PANEL system (laminate / fabric tackboard / glazed panels) added to Global desk series — NOT an acoustic pod and not marketed with an acoustic rating.
spec_findings.recommended_correction: Recategorize away from 'acoustic-pods'. This is an L-shape laminate desk + Divide desk-mounted privacy panel. Do not imply acoustic/sound performance.
spec_findings.notes: Divide product page explicitly: 'a modular desk-mounted panel system that can be added to most Global desk series'; described as visual privacy, not a sealed pod.

spec_findings.claimed: Desk footprint 72"W x 72"D; privacy panel 36"H above worksurface
spec_findings.datasheet_value: Divide panels are configurable heights; the page retrieved did not enumerate a 36" height or confirm the 72x72 desk/DGP1272X6 model dimensions.
spec_findings.recommended_correction: Confirm DGP1272X6 (desk) footprint and DPOST36 (post/panel = 36" implied by suffix) against the Divide CDN pricelist before publishing exact dimensions.
spec_findings.notes: DPOST36 suffix is consistent with a 36" element, but the datasheet pages retrieved did not state heights or the desk model dimensions. Do not present as confirmed.

spec_findings.datasheet_value: Divide offers laminate panels, fabric tackboards, and glazed panels; desk-mounted; laminate desking confirmed for the desk component.
spec_findings.notes: Laminate worksurface + desk-mounted panel is consistent with Divide. Panel finish type (laminate vs fabric vs glass) not specified by the SKU; that is acceptable but could be FLAGGED for buyer clarification.

spec_findings.claimed: Desk-mounted privacy panel that integrates directly with the desk
spec_findings.datasheet_value: Modular desk-mounted panel system added to Global desk series
spec_findings.notes: Mounting description matches the Divide datasheet.
Consistent with Global's standard warranty for this product line.

spec_findings.datasheet_value: Global manufactures office/laminate desking in Toronto, Canada (corporate); Divide page does not state SKU-level country of manufacture.
spec_findings.recommended_correction: Plausible (Global is a Canadian manufacturer and laminate desking is among its Canadian-made lines), but confirm SKU-level country of origin before relying on the 'Made in Canada' claim for procurement.
spec_findings.notes: LEGALLY SENSITIVE. Corporate Canadian manufacturing documented; no per-SKU origin statement found on the Divide datasheet.

config_divergence_note: Categorized as 'acoustic-pods' but is an L-shape laminate desk + Divide desk-mounted privacy panel. Also a bundled/configured item (desk model DGP1272X6 + panel DPOST36); exact 72x72 desk dimensions and 36" panel height could not be datasheet-confirmed. FLAGGED — do not guess panel finish or exact dimensions.
